pages.heading: Cave Centipede
pages.body: Deep caves. Hostile, poisonous and dangerous at close range. Dropped legs make wall-climbing leggings. A leg also combines through brewing with Poisonous

pages.heading: Cave Centipede (cont.)
pages.body: Essence or bottled Komodo Dragon Spit to make Poison Resistance. Bring a way to treat poison before hunting one.
